justification: User decision 2026-10-16 (option 1): rules withheld on purpose because their area has no outline, and listed in data/chapter_scope/not_covered_2026-10-15.json, are stated exceptions to OC-21. DQ-146 counted them as 'shown to no house', so OC-21 could never pass while any exception existed. DQ-146 now counts only rules hidden by accident; the claim text names the list.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a rule hidden but NOT listed still counts; the count rises if any withheld row is not in the list
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 2026-10-16 before: 2,490; after: 1,156. Split measured first: 1,334 listed (northern_beaches 920, canterbury_bankstown 252, leichhardt 139, marrickville 20, woollahra 2, ashfield 1) vs 1,156 unlisted (canterbury_bankstown 934, ku_ring_gai 206, parramatta 16).
falsifiable_check.external_authority: the not-covered list, each entry citing the plan page that limits the rules to an area

real_layer_exempt.scripts/dq_probe_live.py: read-only probe; its real-layer check is running it against production (observed_red)

pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: OC-21 had no exception clause though OC-17 does
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: one helper reading the existing list

functions.name: _withheld_listed
functions.input: the withheld_area_rules selectors in the not-covered list file
functions.output: whole-chapter keys and listed row ids excluded from DQ-146
functions.if_none: both lists empty, so DQ-146 counts every hidden rule as before

break_it.scenario: a rule hidden by mistake inside a listed chapter
break_it.what_happens: it is excluded with the listed ones and never counted
break_it.how: whole-chapter selectors exclude the whole chapter; id selectors are exact. Residual for whole-chapter entries (leichhardt amendment-1, marrickville 2.14).

break_it.scenario: the list grows to hide unmapped rules instead of mapping them
break_it.what_happens: OC-21 passes while rules stay hidden
break_it.how: each entry must cite the plan page and reason (test_every_listed_entry_is_bounded_and_explained); the claim names the list publicly

break_it.scenario: the list file is missing or malformed in CI
break_it.what_happens: the probe would crash instead of counting
break_it.how: the file is committed; json.loads raises loudly rather than counting zero

residual_risk: The site does not yet tell a user that rules for their area are withheld; 'known exceptions are stated' is true in the repo, not yet on the page.
